findings.text: commit 171ca91311 says it restores the file's prior spacing but adds a third blank line at lines 17, 116 and 157, which ruff format --check reports as three reformat hunks, so the style commit introduces the churn it claims to remove and its message misstates the result.

assert declaration == {"type": "http", "url": server.url} compares the composed endpoint against the same server.url the test passed into claude_worker_mcp_config, so it passes whatever the composition does with the url; the live tool call at line 210 is what actually guards the endpoint.

assert len(answers) == WORKERS is tautological because answers is a gather over exactly WORKERS coroutines, so it holds whatever the server returns; lines 220-222 carry the real answer checks and this line only overstates what it verifies.

node_dir now takes runtime_root_candidate's third candidate, the per-session scratch root, for a record that must be shared by every worker on the node, and the tempfile.gettempdir() branch at line 85 bypasses the candidate order; where no runtime directory exists two sessions resolve different directories and each starts its own server, weakening the one-server-per-node guarantee the change exists to provide.
